items.title: 'Detestable, inexcusable, vile': AMC CEO slams Robinhood for tokenized stock offerings
items.summary: AMC (AMC) CEO Adam Aron slammed Robinhood (HOOD) for providing tokenized AMC stock on its platform without approval. Aron described it as "contemptible, outrageous, disgusting, detestable, inexcusable, vile" in a post on X. Watch the video above to learn more.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Volkswagen, Lululemon, AMC
items.summary: ↗️ Volkswagen (XE:VOW3): Shares jumped 6.5% after the German automaker’s supervisory board approved a plan to double job losses to 100,000 and halve its model portfolio as it contends with President Trump’s tariffs and intensifying competition from Chinese automakers.

items.title: Week’s Best: Vanguard’s Important Anniversary
items.summary: Fifty years ago this Monday, Jack Bogle’s Vanguard launched its First Index Investment Trust, now known as the Vanguard 500 Index Fund.  Passive index funds like the Vanguard 500 Index fund are how many investors invest today—as of 2024, there are more assets in passive funds than actively managed ones, according to Morningstar.  For this week’s Big Q feature, we queried four wealth management leaders about what the elections could mean for markets.
